body.statement: For every compatible \(p_x\) and action \(j\in\mathcal A\), \(e_j\in Q_x^*(p_x)\) if and only if \(\mathcal K_j(p_x)\neq\varnothing\). Enumerating the response-fiber bases that generate \(G_x(p_x)\) turns this condition into a finite Boolean combination of weak polynomial inequalities in the observable cells \(p_{xzay}\); this is an observable necessary-and-sufficient certificate, not merely a sufficient dominance check.
body.justification: The certificate identifies precisely when randomization has no minimax value despite three or more actions.
body.gap: Stoye2007ManyTreatments gives an explicit spike-state solution, but no observable categorical-instrument criterion for pure optimality over a restricted joint mean polytope.
body.consumer: Applied analysts can screen every stratum for a certified deterministic action before invoking a mixed-policy solver.
